title: syslog not working on multi-asic platforms
author: abdosi
body:
Issue:

Currently syslog is not working on Multi-asic platfroms. Reason being UDP Syslog Server IP which is docker bridge ip is not getting rendered correctly. As part of this PR#https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/8418 there was change to use 
use JSON to parse ip's output instead of text which is not rendering docker bridge ip.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/58047199/140016530-621a5a3c-b6df-4f08-b275-f87c716a3e8c.png)

Running 
`udp_server_ip=$(ip -j -4 addr list docker0 | jq -r -M '.[0].addr_info[0].local')` O/P is null
